    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AdvanceWeekPopup
    Confirmation popup shown before advancing to the next week.
    BuyPopup
    Confirmation popup for buying shares.
    BuySellPopup
    Abstract base for the buy and sell confirmation popups.
    Challenge
    Wraps the ChallengeType, gives it a visual description and has functions to check if player has completed the challenge, and get advance into a new challenge.
    ChallengeManager
    Challenge Manager contains and manages challenges.
    ChallengeType
    So far we have two different challenges: - UNIQUE_SHARE_REQUIREMENT, You need to have a set amount of different stock in your portfolio - BALANCE_REQUIREMENT, You need to have a certain amount of CURRENT MONEY (not Net Worth).
    Difficulty
    The enum dictates the difficulty and has allocated attributes that effect gameplay and final score.
    Exchange
    Represents a realistic exchange with list of stock and the ability to make a transaction.
    Exchange.Builder
    Standard builder following the standard builder creational pattern.
    ExchangeMenu
    The market screen.
    FilehandlerExchange
    Responsible for handling file input and output operations related to Exchange and Stock objects.
    FilehandlerPlayer
    Utility class responsible for handling file input and output operations related to Player and each of its attributes.
    GameController
    Mediates between the model layer and the view layer during an active game session.
    GameController.HoldingLine
    One line in the sell-all confirmation popup.
    GameController.HoldingSummary
    A pre-aggregated snapshot of one portfolio holding, intended for rendering in a table row.
    GameController.SellAllSummary
    Pre-computed data for the "sell all and quit" confirmation popup.
    GameController.TransactionSummary
    A single row in the transaction history, ready for display.
    HighScoreManager
    This class handles calculations, writing and reading of highscores.
    Main
     
    MarketSimStock
     
    MarketSimulator
    Java translation of the Cookie Clicker bank minigame's stock price advancement logic (M.calculateNewPrice).
    NewGamePopup
    Popup for configuring and starting a new game.
    Player
    Player object that contains all relevant data to play the game.
    Player.Builder
    Standard builder that have base values that are necessary to make a new player.
    Popup
    Base class for all modal popups in the game.
    Portfolio
    Portfolio class contains a list shares and contain methods to interact.
    PortfolioMenu
    The portfolio screen.
    PriceStrategy
    TODO: Implement handling of different strategies to FilehandlerExchange.
    ProgressMenu
    The progress screen.
    Purchase
    Class representing a purchase.
    PurchaseCalculator
    Calculator class for purchases.
    Sale
    Class representing a sale.
    SaleCalculator
    Calculator class for sales.
    SaveManager
    This class implements both filehandlers FilehandlerExchange and FilehandlerPlayer to manage saves by invoking static methods from both.
    Screen
    The main game screen.
    SellAllQuitPopup
    Confirmation popup for the "sell all and quit" flow.
    SellPopup
    Confirmation popup for selling shares.
    Share
    Represents a realistic Share of an stock containing the Stock, amount of the stock and purchase price.
    StandardStrategy
    This strategy uses the designated algorithm from the document to use random to calculate the price but also incorporates difficulty and a random boost.
    StartMenu
    The start menu.
    StartMenuController
    Handles the start-menu actions: starting a new game and loading an existing save.
    StartMenuController.SaveSummary
    A save slot paired with its computed score, used to display and sort saves on the start menu.
    Stock
    Class representing a stock.
    StockFormatter
    Shared formatting utilities for displaying stock prices and changes in the view layer.
    StockMenu
    Detailed view for a single stock.
    StrategyRegister
    Serializable class, just used to get read strategiIDs (as string) to return proper strategies.
    TodayMenu
    The main dashboard shown at the start of each week.
    Transaction
    Abstract class representing a single transaction.
    TransactionArchive
     
    TransactionCalculator
    The interface represents a calculator for transactions.
    TransactionException
    Thrown to indicate a transaction has failed.
    TransactionFactory
